blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In the UK, tea is not just a drink. It is a routine. Every day, people stop for a cup of tea. This small break is a social ritual, and it is often where real conversations happen.

We use the Present Simple to talk about these habits. "I drink tea every morning." "Sophie takes milk, no sugar." "James makes the tea for the desk." These are things people do again and again.

Every office has its own tea habits. Some people like sugar, some do not. Some have biscuits in the drawer. Your office will have its own tea break soon too. Tea breaks are small, but they build real working relationships.

items.q: In the UK, tea is…
options: a routine and a social ritual
items.why: "Tea is not just a drink. It is a routine" — e um ritual social.

items.q: Which verb tense do we use for daily habits?
items.why: "We use the Present Simple to talk about these habits."

items.q: Who makes the tea for the desk?
items.why: "James makes the tea for the desk."

items.q: The text suggests that tea breaks…
items.why: Inferência: "Tea breaks are small, but they build real working relationships."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a tea break is a good moment to talk
tea is bad for the office
people should not stop for tea
everyone must drink tea the same way
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que é "where real conversations happen" — um bom momento para conversar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie no escritório, na pausa do chá da tarde. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! It's eleven o'clock, so it's time for our tea break. We always stop at eleven. Every day, the same time. It is a small habit, but we all like it.

I make my tea with a little milk and no sugar. James takes two sugars — very sweet! Sophie, our manager, likes it strong. She never adds milk. Everybody is different, and that is fine.

The kettle is here, next to the window. It boils in less than a minute, so we wait only a short time. We have biscuits in the top drawer. Today we have chocolate ones — my favourite! I always eat one or two with my tea.

We don't talk about work now. We talk about the weekend, about football, about family. This is a small break, but it is nice. We laugh a lot, and after ten minutes we go back to our desks. We feel better and ready to work again.

So, do you want a cup? Milk? Sugar? Come and join us. The tea break is the best part of the morning.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time is the tea break?
items.why: "It's eleven o'clock, so it's time for our tea break."

items.q: How does the speaker take their tea?
items.why: "I make my tea with a little milk and no sugar."

items.q: Where are the biscuits?
items.why: "We have biscuits in the top drawer."

items.q: What do we learn about the tea break from what the speaker says?
options: it is a happy, relaxed moment
it is a serious work meeting
items.why: Inferência: "We laugh a lot" e "it is nice" — é um momento relaxado e feliz.

items.q: The speaker probably thinks tea breaks are…
options: a good part of the day
items.why: Inferência: "The tea break is the best part of the morning."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I drink tea every morning." Tea means…
items.why: Tea = chá.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sophie takes ___ in her tea, but no sugar."
items.why: Milk = leite; combina com o chá. Ela não usa sugar (açúcar).

items.q: "James likes two spoons of sugar." Sugar means…
items.why: Sugar = açúcar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "At eleven, we stop for a short ___ to have tea."
items.why: Break = pausa: paramos para uma pausa.

items.q: "We eat a biscuit with our tea." A biscuit is…
items.why: Biscuit = biscoito.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem na hora do chá e no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's take a break and have some tea." To take a break means to…
items.why: Take a break = fazer uma pausa, um descanso curto.

items.q: "Come and join us for tea." To join us means to…
items.why: Join us = juntar-se a nós, vir com o grupo.

items.q: "Do you want a cup of tea?" A cup of tea is…
items.why: A cup of tea = uma xícara de chá.

items.q: "The kettle is on — the tea is on its way." On its way means it is…
items.why: On its way = a caminho, vem em breve.

items.q: "Sit down and help yourself to a biscuit." Help yourself means…
items.why: Help yourself = sirva-se, pegue você mesmo.
